describes: Texas school district boundaries, simplified and projected for the /map page

derivedLo.note: Ships inline in /map. Indistinguishable from the full fidelity at phone width.

derived.command: mapshaper tl_2024_48_unsd.shp -filter-fields GEOID -proj "+proj=aea +lat_1=27.5 +lat_2=35 +lat_0=31.25 +lon_0=-99 +datum=NAD83" -simplify 3% keep-shapes -o format=topojson precision=1

boundaries.note: Public domain. NCES EDGE republishes this same geometry with the same GEOID keys.

crosswalk.publisher: NCES Common Core of Data, via the Urban Institute Education Data API
crosswalk.note: Read for two fields only: leaid and state_leaid.
